steps.t: Start every flow from a real customer action.
steps.d: An order placed, a lead gone quiet or a cart left behind starts a journey, so each message has a reason.
Two days after delivery, a care guide or next-step note arrives, not a sales push.

steps.t: Branch on what each customer did.
steps.d: Opened or ignored the email? Each path gets a different next message instead of the same blast.

steps.t: Time the WhatsApp reminder to likely reorder.
steps.d: A restock reminder lands when the product is likely to run out, in your brand voice.

steps.t: Run win-back flows for the lapsed.
steps.d: Customers who went quiet get a reason to return, and every live flow has one job.
